name: Venice Business Directory
description: Find the best local businesses, restaurants, services and things to do in Venice, Florida and nearby Sarasota, Nokomis, Englewood, North Port and Osprey.

cities.name: Venice
cities.blurb: The Shark Tooth Capital of the World: Gulf beaches, a walkable historic downtown and a friendly small-town feel.

cities.name: Sarasota
cities.blurb: Arts, dining and world-famous beaches just up the coast from Venice.

cities.name: Nokomis
cities.blurb: Laid-back beach town home to the Venice Inlet and the Nokomis Beach drum circle.

cities.name: Osprey
cities.blurb: Quiet waterfront community near Oscar Scherer State Park and Historic Spanish Point.

cities.name: Englewood
cities.blurb: Old Florida charm with Manasota Key beaches and Lemon Bay fishing.

cities.name: North Port
cities.blurb: Fast-growing city with Warm Mineral Springs and miles of trails and waterways.

cities.name: Siesta Key
cities.blurb: Powder-white quartz sand and one of America's best-rated beaches.
